title: Cognitive-Economy Criterion as Outcome Test with In-Place-First Default
summary: Human-facing artifacts are admissible when they produce direct human understanding without AI as workaround (the Outcome Test); the default intervention on a reading failure is in-place restructuring of the existing artifact; a bolt-on or felt-additional artifact is the failure-mode signal. A methodology-wide default with named exception conditions.

links.note: ADR-095 is the agent-facing analog of this human-facing Outcome Test; the two are parallel, not hierarchical
one of the six prior audience-bifurcation ADRs; under the alternative reading a complete answer to a different problem (human-facing admissibility), not a step toward Substrate-and-Surface
